company_name: Jiangsu Asia Electronics Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in wet process equipment for semiconductor wafer manufacturing.
summary: Jiangsu Asia Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. (YATEC) is a leading supplier of wet process equipment, focusing on front-end wet etching and cleaning technology for semiconductor wafer manufacturing. The company is committed to promoting the localization of high-end semiconductor equipment in China and offers customized solutions to meet customer needs.

regional_presence.China: YATEC has R&D bases in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, and service teams in major cities across China.
